other|Overlay Controller Xbox Series X -.ne: Xbox Series X Controller Overlay - Pixel Arcade Edition

other|Overlay Controller Xbox Series X -.de: A special-edition Pixel Arcade Xbox Series X controller overlay that follows your gamepad. One purchase includes 3 design options: Dino Top, Dino Center, and No Dino.

other|Overlay Controller Xbox Series X -.n: Overlay Controller Xbox Series X - Water Ring Edition
other|Overlay Controller Xbox Series X -.ne: Xbox Series X Controller Overlay - Water Ring Edition
other|Overlay Controller Xbox Series X -.d: Edisi overlay controller Xbox Series X bertema Water Ring yang bergerak mengikuti gamepad. Trigger LT dan RT jadi pompa air: tekan untuk menyemprot dan mengangkat ring ke tiang, seperti mainan ring air klasik. Tombol, stik, dan bumper ikut menyala saat ditekan, dengan tampilan kaca bernuansa ungu dan pink.
other|Overlay Controller Xbox Series X -.de: A Water Ring Edition Xbox Series X controller overlay that follows your gamepad. LT and RT become water pumps: press them to spray water and lift the rings onto the pegs, like the classic water ring toy. Buttons, sticks, and bumpers light up as you press them, in a glassy purple and pink look.

other|Overlay Controller Xbox Series X -.n: Overlay Controller Xbox Series X - Silk Classic
other|Overlay Controller Xbox Series X -.ne: Xbox Series X Controller Overlay - Silk Classic
other|Overlay Controller Xbox Series X -.d: Edisi overlay controller Xbox Series X bertema Silk yang bergerak mengikuti gamepad. Tampilan putih mulus dengan aksen coral. Trigger LT dan RT berupa meter isi yang menampilkan persentase hingga MAX, stik ikut bergeser, dan setiap tombol yang ditekan muncul sebagai riwayat dengan hitungan kombo. Warna aksen bisa disesuaikan.
other|Overlay Controller Xbox Series X -.de: A Silk Classic Xbox Series X controller overlay that follows your gamepad, with a smooth white body and coral accents. LT and RT are fill meters that show a percentage up to MAX, the sticks shift as you move them, and each button press appears in a history with a combo counter. The accent color is adjustable.

other|Overlay Controller Xbox Series X -.n: Overlay Controller Xbox Series X - Fantasy RPG Gold Edition
other|Overlay Controller Xbox Series X -.ne: Xbox Series X Controller Overlay - Fantasy RPG Gold Edition
other|Overlay Controller Xbox Series X -.d: Edisi overlay controller Xbox Series X bertema Fantasy RPG Gold yang bergerak mengikuti gamepad. Badan bernuansa emas dengan tombol A, B, X, Y berbentuk permata. Trigger LT dan RT terisi sesuai tekanan, dan stik bergeser mengikuti gerakan. Empat input terakhir muncul di gulungan mantra, dan setelah 8 input beruntun aktif Mode Ultimate lengkap dengan hitung mundur. Warna aksen dan tulisan Ultimate bisa disesuaikan.
other|Overlay Controller Xbox Series X -.de: A Fantasy RPG Gold Edition Xbox Series X controller overlay that follows your gamepad. A golden body with gem-shaped A, B, X, and Y buttons. LT and RT fill according to how far you press, and the sticks shift as you move them. Your last four inputs appear on a spell scroll, and after 8 inputs in a row Ultimate Mode kicks in with a countdown. The accent color and the Ultimate text are adjustable.

other|Overlay Controller PS5 DualSense -.n: Overlay Controller PS5 DualSense - Shadow Fight 2 Edition
other|Overlay Controller PS5 DualSense -.ne: PS5 DualSense Controller Overlay - Shadow Fight 2 Edition
other|Overlay Controller PS5 DualSense -.d: Edisi overlay controller PS5 DualSense bertema Shadow Fight 2 yang bergerak mengikuti gamepad. Body 3D dua nada coklat gelap dan coklat terang dengan sambungan yang halus. Trigger L2 dan R2 bergerak sesuai tekanan, stik bergeser mengikuti gerakan, dan tombol, bumper, serta touchpad menyala saat ditekan. Warna aksen bisa disesuaikan.
other|Overlay Controller PS5 DualSense -.de: A Shadow Fight 2 Edition PS5 DualSense controller overlay that follows your gamepad. A 3D two-tone body in dark and light brown with a smooth seam. L2 and R2 move with how far you press, the sticks shift as you move them, and the buttons, bumpers, and touchpad light up when pressed. The accent color is adjustable.

other|Overlay Controller Xbox Series X -.n: Overlay Controller Xbox Series X - Dark Glass Edition
other|Overlay Controller Xbox Series X -.ne: Xbox Series X Controller Overlay - Dark Glass Edition
other|Overlay Controller Xbox Series X -.d: Edisi overlay controller Xbox Series X bertema Dark Glass yang bergerak mengikuti gamepad. Body kaca gelap dengan aksen biru es. Trigger LT dan RT berupa meter isi, stik bergeser mengikuti gerakan, dan tiga input terakhir muncul sebagai riwayat singkat. Warna aksen bisa disesuaikan.
other|Overlay Controller Xbox Series X -.de: A Dark Glass Edition Xbox Series X controller overlay that follows your gamepad. A dark glass body with an icy blue accent. LT and RT are fill meters, the sticks shift as you move them, and your last three inputs appear as a short history. The accent color is adjustable.

other|Overlay Controller Xbox Series X -.n: Overlay Controller Xbox Series X - Esports Angular Edition
other|Overlay Controller Xbox Series X -.ne: Xbox Series X Controller Overlay - Esports Angular Edition
other|Overlay Controller Xbox Series X -.d: Edisi overlay controller Xbox Series X bertema Esports dengan bentuk bersudut tegas dan aksen cyan. Setiap tombol yang ditekan disapu kilatan cahaya, trigger LT dan RT terisi sesuai tekanan, dan stik menampilkan penunjuk arah delapan sektor. Warna aksen bisa disesuaikan.
other|Overlay Controller Xbox Series X -.de: An Esports Angular Edition Xbox Series X controller overlay that follows your gamepad, with sharp angular shapes and a cyan accent. A light sweep crosses every button you press, LT and RT fill with how far you press, and each stick shows an eight-sector direction indicator. The accent color is adjustable.

other|Overlay Controller Xbox Series X -.n: Overlay Controller Xbox Series X - Comic Pop Art Edition
other|Overlay Controller Xbox Series X -.ne: Xbox Series X Controller Overlay - Comic Pop Art Edition
other|Overlay Controller Xbox Series X -.d: Edisi overlay controller Xbox Series X bertema Comic Pop Art dengan titik halftone dan aksen kuning mencolok. Tekan LT atau RT sampai penuh untuk memompa balon di dalam body, dan setelah lima pompaan balon meledak lalu warna body berganti di antara tujuh palet. Stik ikut bergeser, dan tombol menyala saat ditekan.
other|Overlay Controller Xbox Series X -.de: A Comic Pop Art Edition Xbox Series X controller overlay that follows your gamepad, with halftone dots and a bold yellow accent. Press LT or RT all the way to pump a balloon inside the body, and after five pumps it bursts and the body switches between seven color palettes. The sticks shift as you move them, and buttons light up when pressed.

other|Overlay Controller Xbox Series X -.n: Overlay Controller Xbox Series X - Manga Ink Edition
other|Overlay Controller Xbox Series X -.ne: Xbox Series X Controller Overlay - Manga Ink Edition
other|Overlay Controller Xbox Series X -.d: Edisi overlay controller Xbox Series X bertema manga hitam-putih yang bergerak mengikuti gamepad. Setiap tombol yang ditekan memunculkan efek garis ledakan, dan tekan beruntun untuk memunculkan garis kecepatan. Tekan L3 dan R3 hampir bersamaan untuk berpindah ke mode bertekstur dengan efek lingkaran yang menyapu. Trigger LT dan RT terisi sesuai tekanan.
other|Overlay Controller Xbox Series X -.de: A black-and-white manga Xbox Series X controller overlay that follows your gamepad. Each button press triggers a burst-line effect, and pressing in quick succession brings up speed lines. Press L3 and R3 almost together to switch to a textured mode with a sweeping circle effect. LT and RT fill with how far you press.

other|Overlay Controller Xbox Series X -.n: Overlay Controller Xbox Series X - Pirate Ship Edition
other|Overlay Controller Xbox Series X -.ne: Xbox Series X Controller Overlay - Pirate Ship Edition
other|Overlay Controller Xbox Series X -.d: Edisi overlay controller Xbox Series X bertema bajak laut yang bergerak mengikuti gamepad. Trigger LT dan RT mengisi air, tombol A, B, X, Y memunculkan riak dan koin, dan peti harta terisi seiring kamu menekan tombol. Di tengah body, kapal berlayar di peta antara pulau dan tanda X. Warna aksen bisa disesuaikan.
other|Overlay Controller Xbox Series X -.de: A pirate-themed Xbox Series X controller overlay that follows your gamepad. LT and RT fill with water, the A, B, X, and Y buttons make ripples and coins, and a treasure chest fills up as you press. In the middle of the body, a ship sails across a map between an island and an X. The accent color is adjustable.

other|Overlay Controller Xbox Series X -.n: Overlay Controller Xbox Series X - Street Graffiti 3D Edition
other|Overlay Controller Xbox Series X -.ne: Xbox Series X Controller Overlay - Street Graffiti 3D Edition
other|Overlay Controller Xbox Series X -.d: Edisi overlay controller Xbox Series X bertema graffiti jalanan 3D yang bergerak mengikuti gamepad. Setiap tombol yang ditekan menuliskan hurufnya sebagai coretan di tembok dengan warna tombol itu, lengkap dengan cipratan cat, kabut, dan tetesan. Trigger LT dan RT terisi sesuai tekanan, dan stik bergeser mengikuti gerakan.
other|Overlay Controller Xbox Series X -.de: A 3D street graffiti Xbox Series X controller overlay that follows your gamepad. Each button you press scrawls its letter on the wall in that button's color, with paint splashes, mist, and drips. LT and RT fill with how far you press, and the sticks shift as you move them.

other|Overlay Controller PS5 DualSense -.ne: PS5 DualSense Controller Overlay - Art Deco Edition
other|Overlay Controller PS5 DualSense -.d: Edisi overlay controller PS5 DualSense bertema Art Deco yang bergerak mengikuti gamepad. Body 3D hitam dengan ornamen geometris emas. other|Overlay Controller PS5 DualSense -.de: An Art Deco Edition PS5 DualSense controller overlay that follows your gamepad. A black 3D body with gold geometric ornaments. L2 and R2 move with how far you press, the sticks shift as you move them, and buttons light up when pressed. The accent color is adjustable.
